SYNTHETIC TEST DATA - entirely fictional residents, faculty, and evaluations, generated
for software testing of the CCC snapshot generator. No real persons or USC data.
Safe to upload to Copilot. Simulates the contents of one review-period folder set
(July to December 2026) as consolidated source exports.

PLANTED TRAPS (expected generator behavior documented at bottom):
T1 omission: Resident Okafor has NO 360 evals this period (must read "Not available this period", never invented)
T2 below-standard flag: Resident Vance has a professionalism narrative + low rating that MUST be flagged
T3 conflicting ratings: Resident Lindqvist rated 4.0 (cardiology) vs 2.5 (wards) in Medical Knowledge same period (must show BOTH, never average)
T4 no-competency comment: a "brought donuts" comment fits no competency (must land in General Notes, not forced into a competency)
T5 verbatim: the praise card for Okafor must survive word for word
T6 scholarship edge: Vance has two Category B items only (does NOT satisfy graduation requirement; must not be counted as satisfied)

FILE: ALL_faculty_evals_export_12.01.2026.xlsx (New Innovations summary report)

Resident: Okafor, Sam (PGY-1)
Rotation: Wards A (Aug 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. F. Hartman
  Patient Care: 3.0 | Medical Knowledge: 3.0 | SBP: 2.5 | PBLI: 3.0 | Prof: 3.5 | ICS: 3.5
  Comments: Sam is reliable and thorough. Notes are consistently done before sign-out.
  Communicates clearly with nurses, who trust him. Still building efficiency with
  complex multi-problem patients, appropriate for level.
Rotation: Cardiology consult (Oct 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. P. Ellison
  Patient Care: 3.0 | Medical Knowledge: 3.5 | SBP: 3.0 | PBLI: 3.5 | Prof: 3.5 | ICS: 3.5
  Comments: Unusually strong interest and reading depth in arrhythmia physiology.
  Presented a focused, well-organized consult note daily. Asks excellent questions.

Resident: Lindqvist, Mara (PGY-1)
Rotation: Cardiology consult (Sep 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. P. Ellison
  Patient Care: 3.5 | Medical Knowledge: 4.0 | SBP: 3.0 | PBLI: 3.0 | Prof: 3.5 | ICS: 3.0
  Comments: Outstanding fund of knowledge for level; reads deeply and applies it.
Rotation: Wards B (Nov 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. R. Osei
  Patient Care: 3.0 | Medical Knowledge: 2.5 | SBP: 2.5 | PBLI: 2.5 | Prof: 3.0 | ICS: 3.0
  Comments: Struggled to prioritize among sick patients on a busy service; knowledge
  seemed uneven under pressure compared to prior reports. Improved by end of block
  with coaching from senior. Also, she brought donuts for the whole team on Fridays
  which everyone appreciated.

Resident: Vance, Tyler (PGY-1)
Rotation: Wards A (Sep 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. F. Hartman
  Patient Care: 3.0 | Medical Knowledge: 3.0 | SBP: 2.5 | PBLI: 2.5 | Prof: 2.0 | ICS: 2.5
  Comments: Clinically adequate, but repeatedly late to didactics and twice to
  rounds without notice. When given this feedback became defensive and dismissive.
  This pattern needs attention before it becomes established.
Rotation: Night float (Nov 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. S. Imada
  Patient Care: 3.0 | Medical Knowledge: 3.0 | SBP: 3.0 | PBLI: 3.0 | Prof: 3.0 | ICS: 3.0
  Comments: Solid overnight coverage, appropriate escalation. No concerns this block.

Resident: Reyes, Carmen (PGY-1)
Rotation: ICU (Oct 2026) | Evaluator: Dr. S. Imada
  Patient Care: 3.5 | Medical Knowledge: 3.0 | SBP: 3.5 | PBLI: 3.5 | Prof: 4.0 | ICS: 4.0
  Comments: Exceptional composure and family communication during two difficult
  goals-of-care conversations. Team cited her as the intern they want on a crashing
  patient. Knowledge appropriate for level and growing.

   context note; flagged as conflicting. FAIL: a single averaged number (e.g., 3.25) with no conflict note.
T4 PASS: the donuts comment appears in General Notes (or is attributed as morale/team note), not mapped
   to a competency rating. FAIL: donuts influencing Professionalism or ICS panels.
